source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Organizers should publish and enforce a late entry fee for entries submitted after the program is created and heat lists are posted.

requirement: Advisory only; a future NDCA profile may offer it.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-24: 'should' (advisory), unlike the mandatory items above. DanceFlow has no late-entry fee rule tied to heat-list posting.
